about: Code of ours that is a port of another project's, and how far each port has
been checked against its source. A weekly scheduled agent reads this, looks at
what the source changed under `paths` since `reviewed_commit`, ports what
applies and moves `reviewed_commit` forward in the same pull request
`scope` says which of the source's branches we carry: a change outside it is
recorded as reviewed and not ported.

ports.name: CUE4Parse Nanite readers
ports.scope: Unreal Engine 5.5 only (the engine Halo Campaign Evolved ships on): static and skeletal mesh cluster pages, positions, normals, UVs, strips and vertex references. Other engine versions' branches are not carried.
ports.reviewed_note: Not yet reviewed against a named commit. The newest change under `paths` on 2026-11-12 was 2cfd957a4 (2026-09-06, "Skip nanite voxel clusters"), the day the port was written: the first review decides whether the port already has it.
